name: Cubical Marching Squares
definition: An adaptive surface extraction method that unfolds a 3D cube into six 2D faces, applies marching squares to generate isocurves (segments) on each face, and then reconnects these segments in 3D to form components and triangles. It eliminates inter-cell dependency and crack patching by sampling sharp features on faces.
summary: Cubical Marching Squares is an adaptive surface extraction method that converts 3D Hermite data into polygonal meshes by applying Marching Squares to cube faces, eliminating inter-cell dependency and crack patching.
